what: Pill button: an accent-color panel hides off to the left (-100%) inside the button. On hover it sweeps in over .3s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1) and covers the button, and on release it leaves to the left along the same path. The panel is 10% wider than the button and has the same rounded corners, so its leading edge is round. The text color stays the same (with look: ink, it changes along with the panel to the color shown over it).

options.--fx-width: Panel width, default 110% — 100% for square buttons
options.look: On an ink fill, while the panel slides in, text color and border also change over --fx-dur to the on-panel color (--fx-ink, default --kf-on-accent) and the panel color (a white button fills black while its text turns white, like the shop button)
options.--fx-ink: look: text color that changes on ink, default var(--kf-on-accent)
options.--fx-peek: Width at which the panel shows through at the left edge while resting, default 0px — Brand 2px (black strip at the left of the white button)
options.leave: With through, on release it does not go back the way it came in (left) but folds away to the right end — a button the panel passes across (Brand). No rounded corners (--fx-radius: 0; --fx-width: 100%) is used
